title: Windows: Open Downloads button + UI corner radius polish
highlights: Windows: Files page now shows an 'Open Downloads' button in the Transfers card whenever the %LocalAppData%\Entanglo\Downloads\ folder contains at least one received file. Click it to open the folder directly in Explorer — no more hunting for where received files land.

Windows: UI corner radius reduced from large pill/circle values (12–999 px) to a consistent 6 px across all cards, pills, buttons and icon badges. The app no longer uses oval or circular shapes — every surface has a clean squared-off look that feels more native on Windows 11.
